facts.fact: Nate 替老人 Arthur Heavy Leg 打九球局：他一记失误杆（miscue）擦中 8 号球，白球回旋又撞进 9 号，意外替 Arthur 赢下整局，对手随即握手致敬。
facts.anchor: Nate’s miscue just grazed the eight, knocking it in too early, losing the game right there. Then, the white ball’s spin reversed by that contact, it reeled off, tapped the nine on the opposite shoulder than Nate had even meant, meaning it was coming at it from the least likely angle.

facts.fact: 为进池厅，Nate 自称十九岁；Nurse Seine 又让他俯身向酒保展示四个月前颅骨骨折留下的疤作年龄证明。
facts.anchor: “I’m nineteen,” Nate offered, trying to come off insulted but not whiny.

facts.fact: Arthur Heavy Leg 指出那些男孩的骨头就埋在 superintendent（Pratt）房子正前方的低洼处。
facts.anchor: “In front of it, in that low spot, yeah,” Arthur Heavy Leg said, doing his hand to show low spot.

facts.fact: 人物关系：Mooch 随行带着装她死去儿子骨灰的罐子；而 Nurse Seine 走这一趟是为了埋在大白房子前的那个男孩（离这里还有一千多英里）。
facts.anchor: But the one Mooch was here for was her dead son in the jar, while the one Nurse Seine was taking this trip for was buried in front of a big white house, a thousand more miles away.

facts.fact: Christian 用 come-along（绞盘缆）把铁栅栏钩住的那根拉脱——铁条高速弹飞过四人身边落入水中，众人才从豁口钻进军事基地。
facts.anchor: Instead of the whole wall of bars timbering over, that one bar the come-along was hooked to popped out, twirled at blurry speed right past all four of them, close enough that Nate felt its whirr in the air.

facts.fact: Christian 开来一台小型拖拉机，轻易掀翻旗杆的混凝土基座（旗杆又高又细，一推就倒）。
facts.anchor: Easy as anything, Christian tipped the concrete block over, the flagpole flimsy from how tall and tapered it was.

facts.fact: Nate 顺坑滑到齐地处，像拿保龄球一样把颅骨拽出递上去，又摸黑继续掏骨头装进衬衫做的袋子。
facts.anchor: Nate reached into the skull like a bowling ball, closed his eyes to pull, and it came right out.

facts.fact: 章末反转：电话那头是本应已死的 Benjamin Heavy Runner，他说“原来只是一个小印第安人干成了这一切”；同一瞬间，Nurse Seine 把那座小花岗岩钟狠狠砸进 Nate 的头侧，要砸开他的世界。
facts.anchor: “Turns out it was just one little Indian did all this,” Benjamin Heavy Runner said through the phone, Nurse Seine already bringing that little granite clock hard into the side of Nate’s head, to crack his world open.
